# Mailtrap

Email Delivery Platform for testing and sending transactional emails

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mailtrap/.

## Actions

- **Clean Inbox**: Clean an inbox in Mailtrap by deleting all messages.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact from a Mailtrap account.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a project from Mailtrap.
- **Get Contact** (read-only): Retrieve a contact by UUID or email address from Mailtrap.
- **Get Permission Resources** (read-only): Retrieve all resources in account for permission management.
- **Get Sending Stats** (read-only): Retrieve email sending statistics from Mailtrap for a specific account.
- **Get Sending Stats by Date** (read-only): Retrieve email sending statistics aggregated by date.
- **List Accounts** (read-only): List all Mailtrap accounts you have access to.
- **List Contact Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all contact lists for a Mailtrap account.
- **List Inboxes** (read-only): Get a list of inboxes for a Mailtrap account.
- **List Messages in Inbox** (read-only): Get messages from a Mailtrap inbox.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Get a list of projects for a Mailtrap account.
- **List Sending Domains** (read-only): List all sending domains for a Mailtrap account.
- **Reset Inbox Credentials**: Reset SMTP credentials for a Mailtrap inbox.
- **Update contact**: Update an existing contact in Mailtrap.
- **Update inbox**: Update an inbox's settings in Mailtrap.
- **Update project**: Update a project's name in Mailtrap.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in Mailtrap.
- **Create Contact Event**: Create a contact event in Mailtrap.
- **Create Contact Export**: Create a contact export job for a Mailtrap account.
- **Create Contact Field**: Create a custom contact field in Mailtrap.
- **Create Contact List**: Create a new contact list in Mailtrap.
- **Create Email Template**: Create a new email template in Mailtrap account.
- **Create Sending Domain**: Create a new sending domain in Mailtrap.
- **Delete Contact Field**: Delete a contact field by its ID.
- **Delete Contact List**: Delete a contact list by its ID.
- **Delete Email Template**: Delete an email template from a Mailtrap account.
- **Delete Sending Domain**: Delete a sending domain from a Mailtrap account.
- **Get Billing Usage** (read-only): Retrieve current billing cycle usage for an account.
- **Get Contact Export** (read-only): Retrieve the status of a contact export.
- **Get Contact Field** (read-only): Retrieve contact field details by field ID.
- **Get Contact Import Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status of a contact import operation.
- **Get Contact List** (read-only): Retrieve a specific contact list by its ID.
- **Get Email Template** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific email template by ID.
- **Get Inbox Attributes** (read-only): Retrieve inbox attributes from Mailtrap.
- **Get Message HTML Body** (read-only): Retrieve the HTML body of a message from Mailtrap.
- **Get Project by ID** (read-only): Retrieve project details from Mailtrap by project ID.
- **Get Sending Domain** (read-only): Retrieve sending domain details from Mailtrap.
- **Get Sending Stats by Categories** (read-only): Retrieve email sending statistics grouped by categories.
- **Get Sending Stats by Domains** (read-only): Retrieve sending statistics grouped by domains for a Mailtrap account.
- **Get Sending Stats by ESP** (read-only): Retrieve email sending statistics grouped by email service providers (ESPs) for a specified date range.
- **Import Contacts**: Import contacts in bulk to Mailtrap.
- **List Contact Fields** (read-only): Get all contact fields for a Mailtrap account.
- **List Email Suppressions** (read-only): List suppressed email addresses for a Mailtrap account.
- **List Email Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all email templates for a Mailtrap account.
- **Mark Inbox as Read**: Mark all messages in a Mailtrap inbox as read.
- **Update Contact Field**: Update a contact field in Mailtrap.
- **Update Contact List**: Update a contact list's name in Mailtrap.
- **Update Email Template**: Update an existing email template in Mailtrap account.
